fullPassage: Nonlinear editing, on the other hand, is like using a word processing program. All editing systems are now nonlinear computer-based systems that allow random access to any video shot or scene without having to fast forward or fast reverse to find it. Nonlinear systems can create a range of special effects, such as slow motion, wipes and dissolves. Another highlight of a digital nonlinear system is its random access process that makes it easy for an editor to find desired shots or scenes without having to spend time fast forwarding or rewinding videotape. With nonlinear editing, shots or scenes can be easily added or removed anywhere in the program, and the computer adjusts the program length automatically. Linear editing was like composing a paper on a typewriter. If a mistake was made or new information needed to be added the whole piece had to be retyped. If a mistake is made, it is easily deleted and fixed with a few keystrokes, and new information can be added easily.

det.tip: 무작위 random의 반대는 '순서 있는' ordered. arbitrary는 유의어 함정!

questions.passage:
(A) Nonlinear systems can create a <u>range</u> of special effects, such as slow motion and dissolves.
(B) We hiked all day across a snow-covered mountain <u>range</u> near the border.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 range가 (A)와 (B)에서 각각 의미하는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
(A) a range of special effects: '다양한(범위의) 특수효과'라는 뜻으로 range = 범위예요.
(B) a mountain range: 산이 이어진 '산맥'을 뜻해서 range = 산맥이에요.
따라서 (A) 범위 — (B) 산맥 조합이 정답입니다.
사정거리·목장은 이 두 문맥에 맞지 않아요.

[선지 판정] ❌① ✅② ❌③ ❌④
det.tip: a range of ~ = 다양한 범위 / mountain range = 산맥.

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"a single act of pressing a key on a keyboard when you are typing"

det.analysis:
cursor: 화면에서 깜빡이는 '커서'라 정의와 맞지 않아요.
shortcut: '지름길, 단축키'라서 키를 한 번 누른다는 정의와 달라요.
keystroke: '키보드의 키를 한 번 누름'이라는 정의와 정확히 일치해요.
clipboard: 복사한 내용을 담는 '임시 저장공간'이라 정의와 무관해요.

[선지 판정] ❌① ❌② ✅③ ❌④
det.tip: 본문 'with a few keystrokes(몇 번의 키 입력으로)'에 쓰인 단어예요.

questions.passage: With nonlinear editing, shots or scenes can be easily added or removed anywhere in the program, and the computer adjusts the program length __________ (automatic). Linear editing was like composing a paper on a typewriter.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.analysis: 빈칸은 동사 adjusts(조정한다)를 꾸며 주는 자리라 부사가 필요해요. 형용사 automatic(자동의)을 부사형 automatically(자동으로)로 바꿔 'adjusts the program length automatically(프로그램 길이를 자동으로 조정한다)'가 됩니다.
det.tip: 동사를 꾸미는 자리 → 부사. 형용사 automatic → 부사 automatically.

questions.passage: Linear editing was like composing a paper on a typewriter. If a mistake was made or new information needed to be added the whole piece had to be retyped. If a mistake is made, it is easily __________ (delete) and fixed with a few keystrokes, and new information can be added easily.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.analysis: 주어 it(실수)이 '삭제되는' 대상이므로 be동사 is 뒤에 과거분사를 써서 수동태를 만들어야 해요. 뒤의 'and fixed'와 짝을 이루도록 delete를 deleted로 바꿔 'is easily deleted and fixed(쉽게 삭제되고 수정된다)'가 됩니다.
det.tip: is + 과거분사(수동태). and fixed와 형태를 맞춰 deleted.

questions.passage: Nonlinear editing, on the other hand, is like __________. All editing systems are now nonlinear computer-based systems that allow random access to any video shot or scene without having to fast forward or fast reverse to find it. Nonlinear systems can create a range of special effects, such as slow motion, wipes and dissolves. Another highlight of a digital nonlinear system is its random access process that makes it easy for an editor to find desired shots or scenes without having to spend time fast forwarding or rewinding videotape. With nonlinear editing, shots or scenes can be easily added or removed anywhere in the program, and the computer adjusts the program length automatically. Linear editing was like composing a paper on a typewriter. If a mistake was made or new information needed to be added the whole piece had to be retyped. If a mistake is made, it is easily deleted and fixed with a few keystrokes, and new information can be added easily.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: using a word processing program (워드프로세서를 사용하는 것)
det.analysis:
recording a live broadcast: '생방송을 녹화하는 것'은 편집 방식 비유와 무관해요.
composing on a typewriter: '타자기로 작성하는 것'은 뒤에 나오는 선형(linear) 편집의 비유라 반대예요.
rewinding an old videotape: '테이프를 되감는 것'은 비선형이 피하려는 작업이에요.
using a word processing program: 비선형 편집은 '워드프로세서를 쓰는 것'과 같다고 대조하는 흐름에 정확히 맞아요.

[선지 판정] ❌① ❌② ❌③ ✅④
det.tip: 선형=타자기, 비선형=워드프로세서로 대조돼요.

questions.passage: Nonlinear editing, on the other hand, is like using a word processing program. All editing systems are now nonlinear computer-based systems that allow random access to any video shot or scene without having to fast forward or fast reverse to find it. Nonlinear systems can create a range of special effects, such as slow motion, wipes and dissolves. Another highlight of a digital nonlinear system is its random access process that makes it easy for an editor to find desired shots or scenes without having to spend time __________ videotape. With nonlinear editing, shots or scenes can be easily added or removed anywhere in the program, and the computer adjusts the program length automatically. Linear editing was like composing a paper on a typewriter. If a mistake was made or new information needed to be added the whole piece had to be retyped. If a mistake is made, it is easily deleted and fixed with a few keystrokes, and new information can be added easily.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: fast forwarding or rewinding (앞으로 감거나 되감는 것)
det.analysis:
fast forwarding or rewinding: 임의 접근 덕분에 테이프를 '앞으로 감거나 되감느라' 시간 쓸 필요가 없다는 흐름에 정확히 맞아요.
copying or deleting files: '파일 복사·삭제'는 장면을 찾는 이 문맥과 무관해요.
adjusting the total length: '전체 길이 조정'은 뒤 문장의 다른 내용이에요.
composing on a typewriter: '타자기로 작성'은 선형 편집 비유라 여기 안 맞아요.

[선지 판정] ✅① ❌② ❌③ ❌④
det.tip: 임의 접근이라 테이프를 감을 필요가 없다 → fast forwarding or rewinding.
